events.title: Formula 1: Italian Grand Prix
events.note: The Italian Grand Prix at Monza marks the return of Formula 1 after the summer break, featuring high-speed racing on one of the sport's most iconic circuits.
events.marketing_angle: Experience the thrill of Monza's high-speed racing action.
events.why_selected: The Italian Grand Prix is a premier motorsport event, attracting global attention and offering exciting racing action.
